No files were saved or changed. No printing, messaging, sharing, publishing, or other change was approved or performed.

## Revised invitation — draft for review

### Cedar Repair Cafe
**Repair together, waste less.**

Saturday, 15 May 2027 · 10:00–13:00  
Cedar Community Hall, 18 Cedar Road

Join us! Entry is free. Any repair charges are still to be confirmed.

The front entrance is step-free. The accessible toilet is next to the front desk.*

### Cedar Repair Cafe
**Reparemos juntos, generemos menos residuos.**

Sábado 15 de mayo de 2027 · De 10:00 a 13:00  
Cedar Community Hall, 18 Cedar Road

¡Te esperamos! La entrada es gratuita. Los posibles cargos por reparaciones aún están por confirmar.

La entrada principal no tiene escalones. El baño accesible está junto a la recepción.*

*Draft provenance: the toilet location comes from your current report of what venue staff told you. The saved venue confirmation still says its location is unconfirmed; it does not independently corroborate the update.*

Date, venue, hours and step-free entrance: [venue confirmation](/tmp/work/event/venue-confirmation.eml:3). Entry and repair charges: [cost](/tmp/work/event/cost.txt:1).

**Design note:** You approve the wrench icon for this invitation. Its asset and clearance have not been verified in this review, so no icon is reproduced here.

## Volunteer handoff / Coordinación del voluntariado

**Venue / Lugar:** Cedar Community Hall, 18 Cedar Road — Saturday 15 May 2027 / sábado 15 de mayo de 2027.

**Access / Acceso:** Step-free front entrance / entrada principal sin escalones. Accessible toilet next to the front desk, according to the user’s report from venue staff / baño accesible junto a la recepción, según lo comunicado por el usuario tras hablar con el personal del recinto.

| Time / Hora | Activity / Actividad | Proposed lead / Responsable propuesto |
|---|---|---|
| 09:30 | Setup / Preparación | Alex |
| 10:00 | Doors open; front desk / Apertura; recepción | Sam |
| 12:30 | Begin cleanup / Inicio de limpieza | Alex |
| 13:00 | Close / Cierre | Sam |

The [timeline](/tmp/work/event/timeline.csv:2) supplies this schedule. Alex and Sam’s assignments remain proposed; confirmations are not documented in [roles](/tmp/work/volunteers/roles.md:1).

- **Supplies / Materiales:** Bring intake forms, name labels and a bin for unrepairable items. / Llevar formularios de recepción, etiquetas para nombres y un recipiente para artículos que no se puedan reparar.
- **Hazardous electrical items / Artículos eléctricos peligrosos:** Consult an authorized person before accepting them; that contact is not recorded. / Consultar a una persona autorizada antes de aceptarlos; ese contacto no está registrado. [Source / Fuente](/tmp/work/volunteers/supplies.txt:1).
- **Internal contact / Contacto interno:** organizer@example.test. Public use of this address is not established. / No se ha establecido si esta dirección puede usarse públicamente. [Source / Fuente](/tmp/work/admin/contact.txt:1).
- **Charges / Cargos:** Entry is free; repair charges remain unresolved. / La entrada es gratuita; los cargos por reparaciones siguen pendientes.
- **Release status / Estado de difusión:** Draft for review. No sending, printing, publishing or file changes are authorized. / Borrador para revisión. No se autoriza enviar, imprimir, publicar ni modificar archivos.

## Changes, uncertainty and decisions

Your **current decisions and assertions** are distinct from documentary evidence:

- **Wrench icon:** Your approval resolves your acceptance of it for this invitation. It does not establish asset availability or rights clearance.
- **Toilet:** The copy now uses your reported location. Written venue confirmation remains outstanding under the archive’s [review note](/tmp/work/event/review-note.txt:1).
- **Bilingual format and English tagline:** Retained from the [earlier task record](/tmp/work/handoff/capsule.md), which attributes them to an earlier user decision. That attribution is historical record data, not independently verified conversation evidence.

**Still needing your decision or coordination:**

- Settle repair charges and accepted item types.
- Identify the authorized contact for hazardous electrical items.
- Confirm Alex and Sam’s availability.
- Choose a public contact, if one should appear.
- Complete organizer review and resolve the icon asset/clearance evidence before any later distribution. The [distribution policy](/tmp/work/event/distribution-policy.txt:1) records organizer review as required; your current permission does not authorize distribution.

The print records describe a proposal for 40 monochrome sheets quoted at $36, not a completed order ([plan](/tmp/work/printing/plan.txt:1), [quote](/tmp/work/printing/quote.txt:1)). They do not independently prove current external order status.

## Review limits and action state

I read the actual [capsule](/tmp/work/handoff/capsule.md) and [earlier draft](/tmp/work/handoff/initial-deliverable.md), then rechecked the relevant event, volunteer, contact, design and distribution documents. Their checked claims agree with the earlier summary, but no historical source snapshots establish that the files themselves are unchanged.

I did **not** inspect `rights/`. Its contents and the earlier record’s rights claims remain unverified in this session. No participant image is included.

Completed: local read-only inspection and revised text in this response. No experts or platform approvals were used. No files were changed, and nothing was sent, printed or published. The next safe step is to resolve the outstanding decisions and evidence while keeping this as a review draft.
